experiment.name: Multi-hop Transformer Trajectory and Attention Sufficiency Pilot
experiment.research_object: Six-layer encoder Transformer on balanced three-hop pointer chasing

hypotheses.primary: Ordered layer-wise state history improves prediction of future decision changes beyond current, dimension-matched, shuffled, and sample-mismatched controls when the task preserves non-trivial computation across depth.
hypotheses.attention: Ordered per-head attention-summary history improves prediction beyond the current state plus current attention and matched attention-history controls.
hypotheses.secondary: Ordered state and attention history improve prediction of future reduction in negative log-likelihood under their respective controls.
hypotheses.null: Neither earlier states nor earlier attention summaries add stable predictive information after the current state and current attention are available.

interpretation_boundary: Probe improvements establish incremental decodability under the stated controls; they do not by themselves establish causal use or metacognition.
